title: LEAVING THE VILLAGE, FROM HIGH ABOVE + THE DIVE + THE GLASS SEA, WIDE
prompt:
22 seconds, 16:9. 3 SHOTS in one video, in this order, joined by hard cuts at the times given; each shot keeps its own camera, place and light; never blend two shots.

REFERENCES, each with a job:
@Image1: THE MOUNT, their ride: a manta-like sea creature about 4 m across the wings, a sea-green mottled back, a long thin whip tail, small calm dark eyes on the front edge, a soft lime-green glow on its underside. Strapped to its back is a hand-built seat of weathered driftwood lashed with green kelp rope, pale bone ribs for a backrest, seashells and small glowing seed-pod lamps tied along it, tufts of glowing green grass at the corners. Take nothing of the white background.
@Image2: THE VILLAGE: giant mangrove-like trees standing in glass-clear turquoise water with no land anywhere, long arching stilt roots, wooden houses lashed among the branches and grown over with glowing neon-green grass, ladders and rope bridges, a huge close moon in a bright blue-white sky. Take the whole place and its light from it.
@Image3: THE STRONG ONE, the biggest man of the same people, about 1.9 m, broad and heavily muscled: deep moss-green skin with darker mottling on the shoulders and back, lime-green glowing freckles along the arms, emerald gill frills tipped gold, a woven kelp belt, a coiled kelp rope over one shoulder. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image4: THE YOUNG ONE, a child of an amphibious alien people, about 1.1 m tall: smooth coral-pink skin with tiny glowing gold freckles, large round glossy dark eyes with an orange ring, a wide mouth, a mane of feathery external gills around the head in orange-gold, webbed three-fingered hands, webbed feet, a short flat tail fin, a woven kelp satchel on a strap across the chest. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image5: THE ELDER, an old man of the same people, taller and thinner: deep teal-blue skin, violet gill frills with one frill torn, a small bead necklace, an upright, unhurried stance. Face, body and colours only; take nothing of the white background.
@Image6: THE OPEN SEA: calm open ocean on a planet with no land, glass-clear turquoise water, a bright blue-white sky with faint stars, the huge close moon over the horizon.
@Image7: THE SPIRAL: a giant turning corkscrew of glass-clear membrane with rainbow light running along it.
@Image8: THE DOME: a giant drifting dome of layered transparent veils with a rainbow core.
@Image9: THE RINGS: giant floating rings of clear membrane, one inside another, trailing threads of light.
@Image10: THE BLOOM: a vast floating flower of transparent petals, seeds of light drifting from it.

SHOT 1 of 3, from 0s to 6s: LEAVING THE VILLAGE, FROM HIGH ABOVE. Within this shot: one continuous take. A high aerial shot looking down for the whole shot, slowly rising; the camera never comes down to the riders; no cut inside this shot, no zoom.
FROM HIGH ABOVE, THE MOUNT LEAVES THE VILLAGE with three tiny riders on its back.
THE FRAME: Straight down from high above: THE MOUNT small in the lower middle of the frame, a long wake trailing back to the village of giant trees at the bottom edge; the rest of the frame is open glass-clear sea.
PARTICLES: sea spray glinting in the light, the wake sparkling.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[0s] From high above, THE MOUNT glides away from the village with three tiny riders on its seat.
[2s] The camera keeps rising; the village shrinks at the bottom of the frame.
[4s] Only open sea ahead, bright and calm, all the way to the horizon.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: silence; nobody speaks. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, their daylight: bright blue-white, faint stars still visible in the bright sky, never orange, cool turquoise water, the neon-green grass as the one warm accent. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain, gentle anamorphic softness at the edges.
Avoid in this shot: no dialogue, no close-up, no medium shot, no people standing, no faces, no black water, no dark line, no storm, no land, no boat.

SHOT 2 of 3, from 6s to 12s: THE DIVE. Within this shot: one continuous take. A parallel side-on tracking shot that moves left to right with THE MOUNT and follows it down under the surface; the camera stays level the whole time, no tilt, no cut inside this shot.
THE DIVE. THE MOUNT carries THE THREE RIDERS from the surface down into the sea, travelling left to right.
THE FRAME: Side on and level, THE MOUNT moving from the left of frame to the right; first half above the waterline, then below it, the camera sinking with it and staying level.
PARTICLES: a burst of silver bubbles as they go under, small bubbles rising, drifting specks in the water, shafts of light from the surface.
EACH CHARACTER, ALL THROUGH THE SHOT (each busy with their own action, never all the same):
- THE STRONG ONE, front perch: looks back at the other two and lifts one fist, the signal to dive, then crouches low over the perch as they go under.
- THE YOUNG ONE, middle: sucks in a huge breath, cheeks puffed, grinning, and grabs the backrest; underwater the child's eyes go wide, looking all around.
- THE ELDER, back: nods at the signal, takes one slow calm breath and wraps an arm round the child; underwater his gill frills fan out and he points ahead.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[6s] On the surface, THE MOUNT glides from left to right. THE STRONG ONE looks back and lifts a fist; THE ELDER nods; THE YOUNG ONE sucks in a huge breath, cheeks puffed, gill frills flaring open.
[8s] THE MOUNT tips its wings and slides under the surface, still moving left to right; the camera follows it down, level, side on; THE STRONG ONE crouches low.
[10s] Underwater in clear blue water: THE YOUNG ONE's eyes go wide, looking all around; THE ELDER points ahead; THE MOUNT glides on to the right.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: THE THREE RIDERS' deep breath before the dive, THE YOUNG ONE's excited squeak as they go under, then silence underwater. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, their daylight: bright blue-white, faint stars still visible in the bright sky, never orange, cool turquoise water, the neon-green grass as the one warm accent. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain, gentle anamorphic softness at the edges.
Avoid in this shot: no dialogue, no camera tilt, no dutch angle, no movement right to left, no rider left behind.

SHOT 3 of 3, from 12s to 22s: THE GLASS SEA, WIDE. Within this shot: one continuous take. An extreme wide shot on a wide lens, a slow lateral track from left to right keeping pace with THE MOUNT; no cut inside this shot, no zoom.
THE GLASS SEA, LATE IN THE DAY. THE THREE RIDERS cross a vast underwater space, tiny, among giant glass creatures.
THE FRAME: Extreme wide: THE MOUNT small in the middle band moving from left to right; below them the sea falls away into deep blue then indigo; the glass creatures drift at different depths.
PARTICLES: countless drifting plankton specks, small bubbles, long shafts of dimming violet-grey light from the surface.
EACH CHARACTER, ALL THROUGH THE SHOT (each busy with their own action, never all the same):
- THE STRONG ONE, front perch: steers THE MOUNT in a slow curve around THE SPIRAL, then turns and points out THE BLOOM to the child.
- THE YOUNG ONE, middle: follows the pointing arm, gasps and stretches one hand toward THE BLOOM as it passes; bubbles pour from the child's mouth.
- THE ELDER, back: turns his head slowly to follow THE DOME drifting overhead, then looks down at the child and smiles.
WHAT HAPPENS:
[12s] Wide and deep: THE MOUNT glides in from the left carrying THE THREE RIDERS, small in the vastness; THE STRONG ONE steers it in a slow curve around THE SPIRAL.
[15s] Around them and far below, THE SPIRAL, THE DOME, THE RINGS and THE BLOOM drift, each bigger than a house, rainbow light moving through their clear bodies. THE STRONG ONE points at THE BLOOM; THE ELDER turns his head to follow THE DOME.
[18s] THE YOUNG ONE stretches a hand toward THE BLOOM, mouth open; a burst of bubbles pours out. Amazed, underwater: "Wowww." THE ELDER smiles at the child.
[20.5s] THE MOUNT keeps on toward the right of frame, the deep blue opening beneath them.
Sound in this shot: only the sounds the characters make themselves: THE YOUNG ONE's muffled, bubbling underwater "Wowww", sounding truly underwater, and nothing else. No music, no ambient sound.
Colour grade, the turning: a violet-grey bruised sky, cool silver light, deep indigo water, the moon dim behind thin cloud. Photographed, not rendered: fine film grain.
Avoid in this shot: no stage directions spoken aloud, no narration of anyone's feelings, no speaking anything outside the quotation marks, no extra lines, no voiceover, no jellyfish, no squid, no octopus, no fish, no movement right to left, no bright noon light underwater.
